ladder_fix_basis.source: v3-v4 200-game comparison plus user-directed v4 revision
rules: replace Psyduck with a third basic Psychic Energy
bench Fezandipiti ex early when it does not consume a required core slot or worsen the current KO clock

bench Genesect only when Lucky Helmet is already in hand and the core Bench reserve remains available
play Nighttime Mine only when its additional Colorless tax immediately stops the opposing Active Tera attack
preserve v3-like attack tempo, current KO, and practical hit-count clock
allow ML only within the deterministic fallback intent for bench and evolution decisions
